raw: Bankruptcy must inevitably have come of this young Pagan, in Lombard-street, London, and also of a curtained alcove in the rear of the immortal boy, and also of a looking-glass let into the wall, and also of clerks not at all old, who danced in public on the slightest provocation.
en: In Lombard-street, London, bankruptcy would inevitably have come from this young Pagan, and from the curtained alcove behind the immortal boy.
ko: 런던의 롬바드 스트리트였다면 이 젊은 이교도 신(Pagan) 때문에, 그리고 불멸의 소년 뒤에 있는 커튼 쳐진 벽감 때문에 필연적으로 파산했을 것입니다.

raw: Yet, a French Tellson’s could get on with these things exceedingly well, and, as long as the times held together, no man had taken fright at them, and drawn out his money.
en: Yet, a French Tellson's could get on with these things exceedingly well.
ko: 하지만 프랑스의 텔슨(Tellson) 은행은 이런 것들과 함께 아주 잘 버텨나갈 수 있었습니다.

raw: What money would be drawn out of Tellson’s henceforth, and what would lie there, lost and forgotten;
en: What money would be drawn out of Tellson's henceforth, and what would lie there lost and forgotten;
ko: 앞으로 텔슨 은행에서 얼마나 많은 돈이 인출될지, 그리고 얼마나 많은 돈이 잊혀진 채 남겨질지;

raw: what plate and jewels would tarnish in Tellson’s hiding-places, while the depositors rusted in prisons, and when they should have violently perished;
en: what plate and jewels would tarnish in Tellson's hiding-places, while the depositors rusted in prisons or violently perished;
ko: 예금주들이 감옥에서 썩어가거나 폭력적으로 목숨을 잃었을 때 얼마나 많은 은식기와 보석들이 빛을 잃어갈지;

raw: how many accounts with Tellson’s never to be balanced in this world, must be carried over into the next;
en: how many accounts with Tellson's, never to be balanced in this world, must be carried over into the next;
ko: 이 세상에서 결코 정산되지 못할 텔슨 은행의 계좌가 얼마나 많을지;
